Text: A stone fountain bubbles with glowing blue water.
Result: Cool and sweet. You feel much better.
Fail Result: It tastes of old coins. Your stomach twists.

Result: Your flask fills with shimmering water (+1 charge).
You leave the fountain be.

Text: A merchant with an enormous pack waves you over. "Fine wares, fair prices!"
Result: "Pleasure doing business!"
"A fine choice. Use it well."
"Opens most chests. Most."
The merchant shrugs and wanders off.

Text: A wounded adventurer sits against a wall. "Help a fellow explorer?"
Result: "Thank you! Take these, I won't need them."
You find some coins while they sleep.
Fail Result: They shout for help. Something heard that...

Result: You wish them luck.

Text: A chest sits alone in the grass. It has... teeth marks? Or teeth?
Result: Just a chest! Full of gold.
Fail Result: It's a slime wearing a chest! It attacks!

Result: You back away slowly.

Text: A perfect ring of glowing mushrooms. The air smells sweet.
Result: Delicious! You feel strong.
Fail Result: That was not a good mushroom.

Result: The mushrooms glow brighter... and something out there notices you.
You step carefully around the ring.

Text: A small shrine. It is very very quiet here.
Result: The dungeon's noise fades away (Danger back to 0).
You pocket the coins. The silence breaks.

Text: Gold glints at the back of a dark cave. You hear growling.
Result: There's gold... and its owners are home!
Not today.

Text: Something thumps inside a big locked chest. A muffled voice: "Help! Get me out! I'm an Enchanter, I can make it worth your while!"
Result: Click! The lid flies open and a dusty Enchanter tumbles out. "Free at last! Here, my plans. Build me a workshop in your town and I'll enchant your cards."
CRACK! The lock gives way and a dusty Enchanter tumbles out. "Free at last! Here, my plans. Build me a workshop in your town and I'll enchant your cards."
Fail Result: The lock holds. While you catch your breath, the chest wobbles off into the grass. "Come back with a key!" You'll have to find it again.

Result: "Don't forget me!" You'll find this chest again after you rest.

Text: A barn with a sagging roof. Something rustles in the hay.
Result: You dig through the hay and find a few coins and a good stone.
Fail Result: Slimes were napping in the hay! They wake up grumpy.

Result: Up in the loft, an old card is tucked into a beam!
Fail Result: A rotten board snaps. Ouch! And that was LOUD.

Result: You leave the barn to the mice.

Text: An old stone well. The rope still holds a bucket.
Result: Cold, clear water. Your flask is a little fuller (+1 charge).
You drink deeply. That feels better.
Something glints at the bottom of the bucket: a small key!
Fail Result: Plop. The coin sinks. Nothing happens.

Result: You leave the well be.

Text: A deep, cold well. The water glows a little.
Result: The glowing water fills your flask right to the top!
Magic water! You feel MUCH better.
You leave the well be. For now.

Text: The ground here is soft and sagging. One wrong step and you're in.
Result: You edge around the hole. Phew.
Fail Result: The ground gives way! You scramble out, scraped and muddy.

Result: You throw supplies from your backpack in until it's safe to cross.
A clean jump! Something shiny was lying on the far side.
Fail Result: You land short, in the mud. Ouch, and LOUD.

Text: A cellar door in the grass. The steps go down into the dark.
Result: Your torch shows shelves of old jars, and something better tucked behind them.
Your hands find a coin purse and a sack of grain.
Fail Result: Something cold and squishy grabs your hand!

Result: You close the door on the dark.
